title: Lawn Care Job Work Order Form
subtitle: Control mowing, cultivation, irrigation review, treatment, and property handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete lawn care job work order for turf zones, plantings, irrigation features, and service equipment. It connects service plan, product label, site map, and instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified lawn-care technician or applicator must control authorized lawn care work from arrival and baseline findings through change approval, service evidence, testing, and handoff.

sections.guidance: Anchor authorization, assigned work, materials, evidence, testing, and handoff to one controlled job record.

sections.title: Lawn Care scope, estimate, and work authorization
sections.guidance: Separate requested work from the exact approved scope, price boundary, exclusions, and decision authority.

sections.title: Lawn Care arrival, site readiness, and controlled work setup
sections.guidance: Verify actual site conditions before beginning and stop when dispatch assumptions no longer hold.

blocks.label: Site, access, exposure, and work-zone controls
items: Property and treatment boundaries confirmed before work
People, children, pets, vehicles, and movable property cleared or protected
Hidden utilities, irrigation heads, drainage features, and obstacles identified
Slope, wet ground, traffic, heat, lightning, and other weather hazards assessed
Mower guards, discharge controls, blades, and service equipment inspected
Product label, applicator qualification, PPE, and application conditions verified
Water, wells, storm drains, pollinator areas, and neighboring property protected
Mowing height, route, clipping, pruning, and treatment instructions defined
Gate, key, alarm, and access controls preserved
Reentry, watering, cleanup, and follow-up instructions assigned

blocks.label: Pre-work hazard and stop-condition review
items: People, pets, traffic, or property remain in the discharge or work zone
Hidden utility, irrigation, wire, drain, or obstacle location uncertain
Slope, wet ground, drop-off, heat, storm, or lightning condition unsafe
Equipment guard, blade, tire, control, or emergency stop is defective
Product label, qualification, PPE, weather, or application boundary not met
Spray drift, runoff, overspread, spill, or non-target plant exposure
Tree, branch, retaining wall, sinkhole, or structural condition appears unstable
Property line, customer instruction, or protected zone is disputed
Plant damage, disease, or condition exceeds authorized lawn-care scope
Work would conflict with irrigation, construction, occupants, or another vendor

sections.title: Lawn Care measurements, testing, and release verification
sections.guidance: Connect each claimed result to an actual method, acceptance basis, and traceable observation.

blocks.label: Measurement, adjustment, and test results
blocks.guidance: Use the method applicable to: Turf height before and after, Treated or serviced area, Product rate and applied quantity, Soil moisture, pH, or other approved reading, Weather, wind, or rainfall condition, Irrigation, watering, or follow-up interval.

Gates, irrigation controls, furniture, and movable items are restored

sections.title: Lawn Care job work order closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This lawn care job work order is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when weather, chemical labeling, people or pets, hidden utilities, slope, equipment guarding, property boundary, or treatment condition is uncertain. A turf, pesticide, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
